correctness.rationale: For any rank-one projectors P and Q=U*PU on Hilbert dimension >=2, if Q=P, maximal f-divergence with f(t)=t log t is 0. If Q differs, c=Tr(PQ)<1 and the two-outcome channel measuring Q and I-Q maps (P,Q) to distributions ((c,1-c),(1,0)), whose classical KL divergence is +infinity. Quantum maximal f-divergence is data-processing monotone, so S_hat_f(P||Q)>=+infinity. Equivalently the f=t log t support criterion fails for any distinct rank-one supports. The orbit image is exactly {0,+infinity} although same/opposite spectral endpoints are 0 and +infinity. Nguyen--Nguyen--Le Corollary 3.3 explicitly asserts for all states the filled interval [0,+infinity], using a continuity argument invalid for rank-deficient Q. Independent exact matrix check for P=diag(1,0), Q=|+><+| gave c=1/2, positive mass 1/2 outside Q. This verifies a counterexample, not the fate of their endpoint theorems.
